description: This file implements the scheduler metrics handler for a cellular network simulation or management system, including classes and methods for collecting, processing, and reporting various radio and UE metrics, as well as handling events like UE creation, deletion, and HARQ acknowledgments.

classes.name: null_metrics_notifier
classes.description: A final class implementing a no-op notifier for scheduler cell metrics.

classes.name: cell_metrics_handler
classes.description: Main class for handling cell metrics, including event handling, metric collection, and report generation.

classes.name: cell_metrics_handler::ue_metric_context
classes.description: Nested class for maintaining per-UE metrics and computing reports.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell metrics handler for a specified cell configuration.

methods.name: rem_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell metrics handler for a specified cell index.
